cohort: The study included 90 healthy, viable, and normal-weighted puppies (39 small-sized and 51 large-sized) born from 29 purebred, healthy bitches, all delivered via elective Caesarean section.
finding: The mean amniotic fluid leptin (AFL) concentration at term pregnancy was significantly higher in small-sized puppies compared to large-sized puppies, with other studied parameters showing no significant influence.
